observations: Photo 0 shows a large TV screen displaying a bright yellow and blue image with a person on a water ski. On the left side, a menu overlay reads 'SAMSUNG QLED 65Q77T', 'QUANTUM PROCESSOR 4K', 'DUAL LED', 'ADAPTIVE PICTURE', 'ACTIVE VOICE AMPLIFIER(AI)'.

Photo 1 shows the same TV screen from a slightly different angle, with the same menu overlay visible. The text 'SAMSUNG QLED 65Q77T' is clearly readable. The screen displays a person in an orange top and blue pants, with a green background on the right side.
The TV has a black bezel and is placed on a white cabinet with gold trim. A watermark 'BIG SOLOMON'S ELECTRONICS' is visible on both photos.
The screen appears to be on and functioning, displaying vibrant colors and clear text.
No physical damage to the screen or bezel is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: 65" QLED Samsung smart Q77T Smart TV with direct full array 8X
claims.evidence: The model name '65Q77T' and 'SAMSUNG QLED' are clearly visible on the screen in both photos. The 'Q77T' model is known to have full-array local dimming (often called 'direct full array' in marketing) and 8X upscaling (Quantum Processor 4K).
The screen displays 'QUANTUM PROCESSOR 4K', which is Samsung's AI upscaling technology. This is visible in both photos.

The screen shows 'ADAPTIVE PICTURE' and 'ACTIVE VOICE AMPLIFIER(AI)', which are features that suggest intelligent adjustment, but the specific 'Intelligent mode adjust' claim is not directly visible or confirmed.

risks.risk: Screen damage or dead pixels not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the screen showing a solid color (e.g., black or white) to reveal any dead or stuck pixels, or a detailed inspection of the screen edges and corners.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential screen defects

risks.risk: TV not working or missing remote/stand/accessories
risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on/off, changing inputs, and responding to remote commands, plus photos of the remote, stand, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly non-functional or missing accessories

risks.risk: Not genuine Samsung Q77T or refurbished with non-original parts
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the TV showing the model number label, serial number, and any service or repair stickers. Also, a photo of the original box or packaging if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially counterfeit or refurbished

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the TV showing the model and serial number label.
Video of the TV turning on, changing inputs, and responding to remote commands.
Photo of the remote control and any included accessories.
Photo of the original box or packaging if available.
response.reason: The model and brand are clearly visible on the screen, supporting the seller's claims. However, critical risks such as screen defects, functionality, and authenticity cannot be confirmed from the current photos. The item must be verified with additional proof before pricing.
